answer_1.quote: Text style transfer (TST) involves rewriting text to incorporate additional or alternative stylistic elements while preserving its overall semantics and structure.
answer_1.outputs: rewriting text with different stylistic elements such as sentiment or toxicity level

answer_2.quote: In line with previous studies , we evaluate content retention through the BLEU score  and content similarity (CS)  compared to the input sentences.
automatic_metrics: AVG (arithmetic mean of ACC and CS)

answer_3.quote: To complement automatic metrics, we employed a GPT-4-based (gpt-4-turbo; OpenAI, 2023a) evaluation on a sample of 50 outputs from best LLMs according to automatic metrics, following prior work that showed good correlation with humans on machine translation.
methods: few-shot prompt for Content Preservation evaluation

answer_4.quote: We also conducted a small-scale in-house human evaluation on 50 outputs for best LLMs on the sentiment transfer task (for details, see Appendix D).
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are asked to rate each of these aspects on a 5-point Likert scale for a random sample of 50 sentences from the test set, equally split between positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive sentiment transfer tasks.
